frame: one four-legged animal standing side-on on a flat grass line under plain sky, whole body, the same size and pose on the page, no person, no fence. Only the animal changes: a deer with wide branching antlers, or a goat with short curved horns and a small beard.
sentence_nl: Het hert heeft een gewei, de geit heeft hoorns en een sik.
sentence_en: The deer has antlers, the goat has horns and a goatee.

frame: one tall long-legged bird standing side-on in shallow water, whole bird, the same size on the page, plain sky, no fish, no nest. Only the bird changes: a stork with a straight neck and a thick straight bill, or a heron with a thin curved neck and a head plume.
sentence_nl: De ooievaar heeft een rechte hals, de reiger een gebogen hals.
sentence_en: The stork has a straight neck, the heron a curved neck.

frame: one bird sitting upright on a bare branch, seen from the front, whole bird, the same size on the page, plain sky, no cage. Only the bird changes: an owl with a flat round face and big forward-facing eyes, or a parrot with a big hooked bill and a long tail.
sentence_nl: De uil slaapt overdag, de papegaai praat na.
sentence_en: The owl sleeps by day, the parrot repeats what it hears.

frame: one small soft animal crawling side-on along a plain leaf lying flat, whole animal, the same length on the page, no flower, no person. Only the animal changes: a snail with a spiral shell on its back, or a caterpillar with a segmented body and many short legs.
sentence_nl: De slak draagt een huisje, de rups wordt een vlinder.
sentence_en: The snail carries a shell, the caterpillar becomes a butterfly.

frame: one four-legged reptile lying side-on on a flat ground line under plain sky, whole body, the same length on the page, no water, no person. Only the animal changes: a crocodile with a long toothed snout and a ridged back, or a lizard with a small head and a slender smooth body.
sentence_nl: De krokodil leeft in de rivier, de hagedis zit op een steen.
sentence_en: The crocodile lives in the river, the lizard sits on a stone.

frame: one sea creature with claws lying on a flat sandy sea floor line, seen from above, whole animal, the same size on the page, no plate, no net. Only the animal changes: a crab with a wide round shell and legs spreading sideways, or a lobster with a long body, big claws and a fan tail.
sentence_nl: De krab loopt zijwaarts, de kreeft heeft een lange staart.
sentence_en: The crab walks sideways, the lobster has a long tail.

frame: one furry river animal sitting side-on on a flat riverbank line beside plain water, whole body, the same size and pose on the page, no person, no dam. Only the animal changes: an otter with a long tapering tail and whiskers, or a beaver with a broad flat paddle tail and big front teeth.
sentence_nl: De otter vangt vis, de bever knaagt aan bomen.
sentence_en: The otter catches fish, the beaver gnaws at trees.

frame: one closed shellfish lying flat on a plain table line, seen from above, whole shell, the same length on the page, no plate, no lemon. Only the shell changes: a mussel with a long smooth oval shell, or an oyster with a rough round wavy shell.
sentence_nl: De mossel is lang en glad, de oester is rond en ruw.
sentence_en: The mussel is long and smooth, the oyster is round and rough.

frame: one soft boneless sea animal floating in plain water below a flat wavy water line, whole animal, the same size on the page, no diver, no fish. Only the animal changes: a jellyfish with a round see-through bell and long thin threads, or a squid with a long body, two eyes and arms.
sentence_nl: De kwal kan steken, de inktvis spuit inkt.
sentence_en: The jellyfish can sting, the squid squirts ink.

frame: one jumping insect sitting side-on on a bare stem, whole insect, the same size and pose on the page, plain background, big folded back legs. Only one feature changes: very short thick antennae, or very long thin antennae reaching back past the body.
sentence_nl: De sprinkhaan springt ver, de krekel zingt 's avonds.
sentence_en: The grasshopper jumps far, the cricket sings in the evening.

frame: one small wild animal on a flat grass line under plain sky, seen side-on, whole body, the same size on the page, no person, no food. Only the animal changes: a squirrel with a big bushy tail curled up its back, or a hedgehog covered in spines.
sentence_nl: De eekhoorn klimt in de boom, de egel loopt onder de struik.
sentence_en: The squirrel climbs the tree, the hedgehog walks under the bush.

frame: one viewing instrument resting on a plain table line, seen side-on, whole object, the same length on the page, no person, no stars. Only the instrument changes: a telescope with one long tube on a three-legged stand, or binoculars with two short tubes joined side by side.
sentence_nl: Met de telescoop kijk je naar de sterren, met de verrekijker naar vogels.
sentence_en: With the telescope you look at the stars, with the binoculars at birds.

frame: one whole vegetable lying on a plain cutting board on a table line, seen side-on, the same size on the page, no knife, no other food. Only the vegetable changes: a round smooth tomato with a small star of leaves on top, or a bell pepper with a blocky lobed body and a thick stalk.
sentence_nl: De tomaat is rond, de paprika is hoekig.
sentence_en: The tomato is round, the pepper is angular.

frame: one citrus fruit lying whole on a plain table line beside a cut half showing its segments, seen side-on, the same size on the page, no knife, no leaf. Only the shape changes: a lemon, oval with a pointed tip at each end, or a sinaasappel, perfectly round with a small dimple.
sentence_nl: De citroen is zuur, de sinaasappel is zoet.
sentence_en: The lemon is sour, the orange is sweet.

frame: one baked sweet lying flat on a small plain plate, seen from above, whole piece, the same size on the page, no cup, no cream. Only the sweet changes: a small round biscuit with a crimped edge, or a square waffle with a grid of deep square holes.
sentence_nl: Het koekje is rond, de wafel heeft vakjes.
sentence_en: The biscuit is round, the waffle has little squares.

frame: one small soft fruit lying on a plain table line, seen side-on, drawn large enough to show its surface, the same size on the page, no bowl, no cream. Only the fruit changes: a smooth round cherry on a long stalk, a heart-shaped strawberry with seeds and a leafy cap, or a raspberry made of tiny round bumps.
sentence_nl: De kers heeft een pit, de aardbei heeft zaadjes en de framboos is zacht.
sentence_en: The cherry has a stone, the strawberry has seeds and the raspberry is soft.

frame: one large round fruit lying on a plain table line, seen side-on, whole and uncut, the same size on the page, no knife, no candle, no face. Only the skin and top change: a pumpkin with deep ribs and a thick woody stalk, or a melon with a smooth net-patterned skin and no stalk.
sentence_nl: De pompoen heeft ribbels, de meloen heeft een netje op de schil.
sentence_en: The pumpkin has ribs, the melon has a net on its skin.

frame: one nut lying on a plain table line, seen from above, whole and closed, the same size on the page, no bowl, no nutcracker. Only the nut changes: a peanut in a long pod with a waist, a walnut with a round wrinkled shell, or an almond, flat, oval and pointed.
sentence_nl: De pinda zit in een dop, de walnoot is rond en de amandel is plat.
sentence_en: The peanut is in a pod, the walnut is round and the almond is flat.

frame: one empty cooking pan resting on a flat hob line, seen side-on, the same handle length on the page, no lid, no food, no flame. Only the pan changes: a deep saucepan with straight high sides, or a frying pan with a wide flat base and low sloping sides.
sentence_nl: In de steelpan warm ik melk op, in de koekenpan bak ik eieren.
sentence_en: In the saucepan I warm up milk, in the frying pan I fry eggs.

frame: one empty kitchen strainer resting on a plain counter line, seen side-on, the same width on the page, no food, no water, no tap. Only the strainer changes: a sieve, a bowl of fine mesh on a long handle, or a colander, a bowl full of holes on a ring foot with two side handles.
sentence_nl: De thee gaat door de zeef, de pasta gaat in het vergiet.
sentence_en: The tea goes through the sieve, the pasta goes into the colander.

frame: one heat source with small flames against a plain wall on a flat floor line, seen from the front, the same size on the page, no person, no clock, nothing standing on top. Only the heat source changes: an open fireplace built into the wall with a mantel, or a free-standing iron stove with a small door and a pipe.
sentence_nl: De haard zit in de muur, de kachel staat in de kamer.
sentence_en: The fireplace is in the wall, the stove stands in the room.

frame: one textile hanging over a plain wooden rail on a bare indoor wall, seen from the front, the same rail on the page, no pattern, no person. Only the textile changes: a small thick towel with a hanging loop and a woven border, or a large thin flat sheet hanging almost to the floor.
sentence_nl: Met de handdoek droog ik me af, het laken ligt op het bed.
sentence_en: I dry myself with the towel, the sheet lies on the bed.

frame: one floor-cleaning tool standing against a plain wall on a flat floor line, seen side-on, the same height on the page, no person, no dust pile. Only the tool changes: a vacuum cleaner with a body on wheels, a hose and a long tube, or a broom with a long stick and a row of bristles.
sentence_nl: De stofzuiger maakt lawaai, de bezem is stil.
sentence_en: The vacuum cleaner is noisy, the broom is quiet.

frame: one long-handled garden tool leaning against a plain wall on a flat soil line, seen from the front, the same height on the page, under plain sky, no person, no plants. Only the head changes: a shovel with a wide flat blade, or a rake with a row of short teeth.
sentence_nl: Met de schep graaf je een gat, met de hark haal je bladeren bij elkaar.
sentence_en: With the shovel you dig a hole, with the rake you gather leaves.

frame: one paintbrush lying flat on a plain table line, seen from above, whole brush, the same length on the page, no paint, no tin, no canvas. Only the brush changes: a wide flat brush for walls with a thick handle, or a thin pointed brush for pictures with a long slim handle.
sentence_nl: Met de kwast verf ik de muur, met het penseel schilder ik een bloem.
sentence_en: With the brush I paint the wall, with the fine brush I paint a flower.

frame: one empty seat standing on a flat floor line against a plain wall, seen from the front at a slight angle, the same seat height on the page, no person, no pattern. Only the seat changes: a stool with no back and no arms, or an armchair with a high padded back and two arms.
sentence_nl: De kruk heeft geen leuning, de fauteuil heeft een hoge leuning.
sentence_en: The stool has no back, the armchair has a high back.

frame: one small square plate fixed on a plain wall, seen straight from the front, the same size and position on the page, no cable, no hand, no plug. Only the plate changes: a socket with two round holes, or a light switch with one wide rocker button.
sentence_nl: Het stopcontact is voor de stekker, de schakelaar is voor het licht.
sentence_en: The socket is for the plug, the switch is for the light.

frame: one small metal fastener lying flat on a plain table line, seen side-on, whole object, the same length on the page, no hammer, no wood. Only the fastener changes: a nail with a smooth shaft and a flat round head, or a screw with a spiral thread and a slotted head.
sentence_nl: De spijker sla je erin, de schroef draai je erin.
sentence_en: You hammer the nail in, you turn the screw in.

frame: one hand tool lying flat on a plain workbench line, seen from above, whole tool, the same length on the page, no screws, no bolts, no hand. Only the tool changes: a screwdriver with a round grip and a thin shaft with a flat tip, or a spanner with an open jaw at each end.
sentence_nl: De schroevendraaier is voor schroeven, de moersleutel voor moeren.
sentence_en: The screwdriver is for screws, the spanner for nuts.

frame: one piece of legwear lying flat on a plain table line, seen from the side, the same foot size on the page, no shoe, no pattern, no person. Only the length changes: a short sock that ends above the ankle, or a long stocking that reaches up past the knee.
sentence_nl: De sok is kort, de kous is lang.
sentence_en: The sock is short, the stocking is long.

frame: one shirt laid flat on a plain table line, seen from the front, buttoned, the same shirt at the same size on the page, no person, no pattern; a small ring marks the featured part at normal size. Only the ringed part changes: a sleeve or the collar.
sentence_nl: De mouw is te lang en de kraag is te krap.
sentence_en: The sleeve is too long and the collar is too tight.

frame: one open summer shoe lying flat on a plain floor line, seen from above, the same sole shape and size on the page, no foot, no pattern. Only the straps change: a sandal with straps across the foot and a buckled strap round the heel, or a flip-flop with only a thin forked strap from between the toes.
sentence_nl: De sandaal heeft een gesp, de slipper heeft een bandje tussen je tenen.
sentence_en: The sandal has a buckle, the flip-flop has a strap between your toes.

frame: one small piece of jewellery lying flat on a plain table line, seen from above at life size, the same size on the page, no stones, no box. Only the jewel changes: an earring, a curved hook with a small hanging drop, or a brooch, a flat round ornament with a pin across the back.
sentence_nl: De oorbel hangt aan je oor, de broche zit op je jas.
sentence_en: The earring hangs from your ear, the brooch sits on your coat.

frame: one sports bat lying flat on a plain floor line, seen from above, whole object, the same length on the page, no ball, no water, no hand. Only the head changes: a racket with an oval frame strung with a criss-cross of strings, or a paddle with one solid flat blade.
sentence_nl: Met het racket sla je de bal, met de peddel duw je het water weg.
sentence_en: With the racket you hit the ball, with the paddle you push the water away.

frame: one piece of swimming gear lying on a plain poolside line, seen side-on, the same size on the page, no person, no splash. Only the gear changes: a snorkel, a bent tube with a mouthpiece, or swimming goggles, two small eye cups on a strap.
sentence_nl: Met de snorkel adem je, met de zwembril kijk je onder water.
sentence_en: With the snorkel you breathe, with the goggles you see under water.

frame: one small narrow boat floating side-on on a flat wavy water line, seen slightly from above, the same length on the page, no person, no paddle. Only the top changes: a canoe, open from end to end with seats inside, or a kayak, closed on top with one round hole to sit in.
sentence_nl: De kano is open, de kajak is dicht.
sentence_en: The canoe is open, the kayak is closed.

frame: one string instrument beside a plain wooden chair on a flat floor line, seen from the front, the same chair at the same scale on the page, no player, no music stand. Only the instrument changes: a small violin standing on its side against a chair leg, or a tall cello standing on its spike beside the chair.
sentence_nl: De viool is klein, de cello is groot.
sentence_en: The violin is small, the cello is big.

frame: one brass wind instrument lying on a plain table line, seen side-on, whole instrument, the same length on the page, no player, no music. Only the middle changes: a trumpet with three upright valve buttons, or a trombone with a long sliding tube bent in a narrow loop.
sentence_nl: De trompet heeft knoppen, de trombone heeft een schuif.
sentence_en: The trumpet has valves, the trombone has a slide.

frame: one adult knee seen from the front, the leg slightly bent, bare skin, the same leg at the same size on the page, plain background, no hand. Only one mark on the knee changes: an open cut with short torn edges, or a sticking plaster with a pad stuck over it.
sentence_nl: De wond is klein en de pleister zit erop.
sentence_en: The wound is small and the plaster is on it.

frame: the koe card drawing without its udder, short horns and a heavy body, standing side-on on a flat grass line under plain sky, every animal identical in size and shape, no fence, no person. Only the number changes: one animal, or three animals side by side with gaps between them.
sentence_nl: Het rund staat alleen, de runderen staan in de wei.
sentence_en: The animal stands alone, the cattle stand in the meadow.
